description: This file is a Perl script used to parse and extract target, device, architecture, and kernel information from makefiles within a specific project directory, primarily for build configuration purposes.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information such as name, architecture, kernel versions, and features from the make command output.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profiles and names from make command output, including handling alternative device names.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Aggregates target and subtarget information by scanning specific directories and invoking parsing functions.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Fetches device information for a given target/subtarget by invoking parse_devices.
